candidates.old:
BCC kind_on_page
    INC v_ptr + 1
.kind_on_page
    LDA (v_ptr)                     \ 65C02 opcode
    STA &C0
    LDY #1
    LDA (v_ptr),Y
    STA &C1
    LDA ck_bank,X
    BEQ in_hazel                    \ bank 0: HAZEL
    LDY ck_restore_lo,X             \ Y, not A: A is the bank
    STY compiled_vec
    LDY ck_restore_hi,X
    STY compiled_vec + 1
    LDX #&04                        \ bank 4 again after
    JSR compiled_call
    JMP columns
.in_hazel                           \ straight into the kind: no JMP (compiled_vec)
    LDA ck_restore_lo,X
    STA hazel_restore + 1
    LDA ck_restore_hi,X
    STA hazel_restore + 2
.hazel_restore
    JSR hazel_restore               \ self-modified: the kind's restore
    JMP columns

candidates.summary: restore_block's compiled-part entry: the v_ptr + 11 page-cross test becomes BCS to an out-of-line INC stub, so the hot path falls through (not-taken branch 2 cycles, not 3).
candidates.equivalence: BCC kind_on_page / INC v_ptr+1 / kind_on_page becomes BCS kop_next_page / kind_on_page ... kop_next_page: INC v_ptr+1 / BRA kind_on_page. Same v_ptr after either path; the next instruction is LDA (v_ptr), which sets N and Z, and C is unused after (annotations: C=? and nothing downstream reads it; the restore kinds and compiled_call set their own). Rare path (measured about 0.06 a pass, INC 0.3 cycles/5) costs 11 cycles instead of 7. kind_on_page and the rest of the window are untouched, in_hazel/JMP columns unchanged; the stub sits after the last JMP columns, before the SKY_MODE=0 .cached, which is only reached by labels, so nothing falls into it (the line before is an unconditional JMP).
candidates.relies_on: bank 4 code after the window moves +2 bytes (BCS 2, INC 2 and BRA 2 against BCC 2 and INC 2). Checked by assembling a scratch copy of the bench build (-D DEBUG_LIVES=1, SKY_HELI=1) and comparing every label span under 400 bytes and every branch in &9000-&B3FF before and after: the only taken-branch page-crossing change is in compact (BEQ gathered at 9EFD stops crossing, a cold routine), and the only table/label span whose page-crossing changed is geom (code, not a table); ck_bank, ck_restore_lo/hi, ck_index and the straight sprite tables keep their crossing status. Window-internal branches: BEQ in_hazel, BCS kop_next_page (forward about 56 bytes) and BRA kind_on_page are all within one page-crossing-free hop for the hot path (BCS not taken). BRA columns (instead of JMP) is not possible: columns is 157 bytes back. kop_next_page is unique across src/ (grep). In SKY_MODE=0 the same text assembles (.cached follows the stub).
